cta.title: Ready to Practice?
cta.description: Start trading with virtual money and apply what you've learned

q1.question: What is paper trading?
q1.answer: Paper trading is simulated trading with virtual money. It allows you to practice trading strategies without risking real funds.

q2.question: How do I get started?
q2.answer: Create a free account and you'll automatically receive 1,000,000 NOK in virtual currency to practice with.

q3.question: Is this for beginners?
q3.answer: Yes! Our guide is designed for complete beginners. We explain everything in plain language without confusing jargon.
